sloka: तत्रैन्द्रेण नरश्रेष्ठ भागेन रघुनन्दन ।प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते तारणार्थं मम प्रभो ।। ७.७६.४६ ॥
transliteration: tatraindreṇa naraśreṣṭha bhāgena raghunandana ।pratigṛhṇīṣva bhadraṁ te tāraṇārthaṁ mama prabho ।। 7.76.46 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, O delight of the Raghus, O lord, please accept this eastern part (Indra's domain) for my salvation; may good fortune be yours.
